regime.headline: Markets trading a rates-led tightening regime: long-end yields and global sovereigns driving selective risk dislocations while credit and equity breadth remain mixed.
regime.answer: Evidence shows a pronounced long-end Treasury and global sovereign yield move coinciding with a firm dollar and weaker gold, while credit spreads remain comparatively tight and AI/semiconductor breadth outperforms. This is rates-led tightening with selective sector resilience rather than broad risk-off.
regime.implication: Treat duration and real-yield risk as the dominant macro impulse. Cross-asset transmission to credit and broad equities is incomplete, so sector and breadth dispersion can persist until credit, breadth or volatility confirm broader risk repricing.
regime.whatWouldChangeMind: Sustained HY/IG widening with rising equity volatility and deteriorating breadth, or a decisive fall in long real yields, would change the rates-led interpretation.

lenses.label: US rates / real yields
lenses.reaction: Nominal long yields rose to multi-year highs and real 10Y yields increased.
lenses.interpretation: Long-end pressure is being driven by real-yield and term-premium components; long yields are the dominant story.
unresolvedSignals: Fed effective-rate cross-check remains open in the Dossier lens.

lenses.label: Global sovereign bonds
lenses.reaction: A global sovereign-yield gauge approached 4%, indicating broad duration pressure beyond the US.
lenses.interpretation: Evidence supports a global long-end tightening component rather than an isolated US move.

lenses.label: Equity breadth
lenses.reaction: Large-cap participation is weaker while AI/semiconductor breadth remains strong and concentrated.
lenses.interpretation: Index performance is being supported by narrow leadership; broad confirmation of either risk-on or risk-off is absent.

lenses.label: Tech / AI / Semiconductors
lenses.reaction: SMH and AI-basket breadth remain strong and company-specific catalysts persist.
lenses.interpretation: Tech/AI remains the main source of selective risk-taking, but its concentration can mask weak broader participation.

lenses.label: Energy / product tightness
lenses.reaction: Regional distillate production and stocks fell and product cracks stayed elevated despite mixed crude direction.
lenses.interpretation: Refined-product constraints remain an inflationary channel that can keep long yields elevated even when crude itself is volatile.
unresolvedSignals: US distillate export series remains a Dossier research gap.

lenses.label: Gold / safe haven
lenses.reaction: Gold weakened modestly as yields and the dollar rose.
lenses.interpretation: Real yields and dollar strength are currently dominating safe-haven demand.
